name: WAINUA
indications_original: WAINUA is indicated for the treatment of the polyneuropathy of hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis in adults.
contraindications_original: • The recommended dosage of WAINUA is 45 mg administered by subcutaneous injection once monthly. ( 2.1 ) • Administer WAINUA into the abdomen or upper thigh region; the back of the upper arm can be used if a healthcare provider or caregiver administers the injection. ( 2.2 )
